name: Traveller 2
description: Traveller 2 has a brown ponytail, olive jacket, cargo trousers and backpack. The skinned character uses the shared 24-joint Fjordfall humanoid rig and all nine locomotion, boat and skating clips.
attribution: Traveller 2 by Jonathan Maddison, Generated Assets (CC-BY-4.0). Model created with Meshy.

source.description: Meshy image-to-3D from an authored T-pose reference; bound to the preserved rider rig in Blender
source.referenceRights: Jonathan Maddison confirmed ownership of the reference images and authorized sharing the resulting characters on 2026-09-16.

notes: Authored clips included; game IK, foot contact solving and cloth shaders are not included.
